lines.text: Two stickmen got stranded on a tiny tropical island.
lines.say: Two stickmen got stranded on a tiny tropical island.

lines.text: While one worked hard building a hut, the other relaxed in the sun.
lines.say: While one worked hard building a palm hut, the other relaxed in the sun.

lines.text: And the second it was finished, guess who claimed the top spot.
